Even though the dialogue in the Campaign suggests otherwise, the newly acquired upgrades are automatically retrofitted in previously manufactured vehicles. <ref>http://forums.bistudio.com/showthread.php?141087-Afterburner-%28campaign%29</ref>


== Walrus & Manta ==

* Volcanic upgrade
* Icelands upgrade
* Marshes upgrade

=== Walrus ===

* Turbo
The Turbo module boosts engine output, causing an increase in speed for a short period of time.

=== Manta ===

* Afterburners
The Afterburners inject fuel into the Manta's exhaust, increasing speed for a short period of time.
